title: A1 amendment 1 — GPU worker becomes a pinned input; LT1 RED retracted

budget.basis: RD2 amortized proxy 22.680409907679 s/call; 18 alias probes + 18 controls = 36 calls ~= 816.5 s ~= 0.2268 GPU-h, plus load/merge/re-tokenize overhead. The 0.5 GPU-h ceiling is the order's, not a measurement.

unchanged.note: The prediction, budget, rows, prompt and procedure are NOT touched by this amendment. Only the input set moves.
procedure: 1. Load each pinned C7 r3 checkpoint below (sha-verified) with A1 OFF.
2. Apply the merge to the LOADED state: repo.alias_fold_merge = True, then repo.alias_fold_pass(). Record every decision receipt (reason, lineage, width, base_shared_with_edges).

3. Re-tokenize each produced digest with the GPT-OSS tokenizer and record digest_tokens vs arena width 96 BEFORE claiming single-mount fit. Over-width digests take the existing LSR-P2C width-guard split; the receipt must say so.
4. Read each alias probe under the plain production prompt.
5. Read the NON-alias controls unchanged; any control that moves is a STOP.
unchanged.read_prompt: PLAIN PRODUCTION probe template, scripts/grm_e2e_session.py:188-190 — "Recall probe. What is the current {fact_id} value? Reply with only the value." NO C7 abstention clause is added (RD2 "Production ladder / EB1 prompt").

registered_prediction.note: The CPU gates establish EVIDENCE SUFFICIENCY only (the mounted digest contains alias, base and value, under width). Whether GPT-OSS-20B READS it correctly is exactly what this contrast measures and is NOT claimed by any CPU receipt.

unchanged.rows: 23 unchanged (8 RD2 + 10 C7 answerable + 5 C7 controls)

worker_contract.gpu_contention: flock --wait; operator has right of way

worker.fake_vs_real: Identical control flow; the ONLY difference is the loader (_load_fake vs _load_gpu) and which tokenizer measures the width receipt.
worker.gate: python3 scripts/grm_a1_gpu_contrast.py --fake — drives every branch on the CPU doubles: all 23 rows, resume-after-interrupt, drift RED, over-width path. See tests/test_grm_a1_gpu_contrast.py.
worker.reason: The registration previously named no worker because the seat had not written one. It is now an INPUT and is sha-pinned like every other input, so the lead runs the exact bytes the fake-path gate exercised.
worker.self_pin_note: The worker EXCLUDES its own path from the drift set and checks it separately (verify_self), recording worker_provenance on every row. A self-pinned file inside its own drift set can never be edited without a same-breath re-amendment, and the two failures — "an input moved" vs "the worker is not the reviewed bytes" — are different facts.
